LanguageData.RM_GreyLampWatcherMsg: A fessk has come to the edge of the light around {0}, and is watching it from the dark.
LanguageData.RM_GreyLampScrapeMsg: Fresh scrape-sign in the silt at the edge of the light around {0}. Something big has been reading this lamp.
LanguageData.RM_GreyLampGiantText: A light burning this bright for this long reads, to the reefback, as a rival's mark standing on its ground. It is coming for {0}.\n\nIt wants the lamp, not the ship and not your people. Switch the lamp off and it will lose interest and go back into the murk.
